title: WCD Telangana Notification 2026 - Apply Online for 264 Anganwadi Teacher and Worker Posts
description: Women and Child Development Telangana (WCD Telangana) has released an official notification for the recruitment of 264 Anganwadi Teacher and Anganwadi Helper Positions. Candidates who have completed their 10th or 12th can apply for the WCD Telangana Notification 2026 . For more details like age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts, see below. The application process has already started.
